episodes.synopsis: After Yukino announced that she was ready to name her request to the Service Club, a long silence followed… but that silence is about to broken.
episodes.title: In Due Time, the Seasons Change and the Snow Melts

episodes.synopsis: Isshiki approaches the Service Club with and interesting proposition, but Yukino would like to handle this time-sensitive challenge on her own.
episodes.title: That Key Was Never Handled Until Today

episodes.synopsis: What is a prom, exactly? Yukino and Iroha have a plan to show both Hachiman and the student body the answer to that question… with Yui’s help, of course!
episodes.title: Iroha Isshiki is the Strongest Junior, as Expected

episodes.synopsis: The Student Council’s prom plans sour after a shocking school policy reversal — and to make matters worse, an unexpectedly familiar messenger delivers the bad news.
episodes.title: By Chance, Yui Yuigahama Thinks of the Future

episodes.synopsis: Hachiman is determine to help bring the prom to life, but Yukino isn’t keen on accepting his help. Luckily Hachiman has a plan — one that uniquely involves the Service Club.
episodes.title: Shizuka Hiratsuka Deeply Longs for the Days Past

episodes.synopsis: First step in Hachiman’s plan? Rally the troops! Together they’ll create a prom proposal so awful, the PTO will have no choice but to choose Yukino’s instead.
episodes.title: Once again, Hachiman Hikigaya Makes a Speech

episodes.synopsis: For Hachiman’s plan to succeed, they’ll need allies from other schools. Communicating with those allies, however, is easier said than done…
episodes.title: Until the End, Yui Yuigahama Will Continue Watching Over Them

episodes.synopsis: Pushing a dummy event like a second prom is a great idea on Hachiman’s part, but the tactic isn’t foolproof against Yukino’s mother. Good thing he has an ace up his sleeve…
episodes.title: Wishing That, at the Very Least, I Don't Make Any More Mistakes

episodes.synopsis: Hachiman has a new objective: granting Yui’s wish. First step? Help her bake something delicious for Komachi, and perhaps include Yui’s mom’s “secret ingredient.”
episodes.title: A Whiff of That Fragrance Will Always Bring Memories of That Season

episodes.synopsis: Will prom succeed without a hitch? Or is the real trouble lying in wait once prom comes to an end?
episodes.title: Gallantly, Shizuka Hiratsuka Moves Forward

episodes.synopsis: Now that the club has disbanded, they’ll continue to drift even further apart — but before they do, Yui has one final wish to make.
episodes.title: Only a Heated Touch Truly Conveys the Sentiment

episodes.synopsis: One final hurdle, and the prom situation will finally be over… but will Hachiman’s search for something genuine be so easily resolved?
episodes.title: My Teen Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected
